_comment: Copy the "Mudbase" section below into MudbaseShowcase.Ecommerce/appsettings.Development.json (or set the equivalent Mudbase__<Key> environment variables in production) with your own provisioned project's values.

Mudbase._comment_PaymentLinkProxyBaseUrl: Base URL of the deployed Next.js reference storefront whose /api/checkout/pay-link route holds the org owner/admin merchant credential needed to create Payment Links. This app never creates payment links itself — see README 'Payment flow'.
